messages:
tariq (newhire): morning all — first day setup hiccup. I can connect to WireGuard but `ssh bastion` hangs. Seems like TCP flows start then drop. macOS Big Sur, company wifi. Any ideas? :confused:

elaine: welcome! do you have another VPN or corporate proxy running? sometimes the old corporate proxy agent forces a system proxy that breaks split-tunnel.

tariq (newhire): yup we have an old corp-proxy agent installed from my previous company. didn't think it would interfere. how do I check?

sre-oncall: quick checks: 1) `scutil --proxy` to see system proxy settings, 2) `netstat -rn` to inspect route table, 3) `wg show` to confirm peer data.

tariq (newhire): `scutil --proxy` shows HTTPProxy 127.0.0.1 port 3128 set. `wg show` handshake ok. `netstat -rn` shows default via 10.0.0.1 and 10.60.0.0/16 via utun2.

elaine: aha — the proxy at localhost forces apps like ssh to route via a local HTTP proxy (some tools ignore it but others get stuck). try unsetting the proxy env vars in your shell: `unset http_proxy https_proxy HTTP_PROXY HTTPS_PROXY` and then `ssh -v bastion`.

tariq (newhire): `unset` then ssh still stalls but `ssh -v` shows it's trying to open TCP then no ack.

grant: mac apps might still use the system proxy even if env vars unset. In network settings, uncheck "Use HTTP Proxy" for your active network service or remove the localhost proxy entry. Also check any launchd agent like `com.corp.proxyagent` with `launchctl list`.

tariq (newhire): found `com.oldcorp.proxy` in `launchctl list`. unloaded it and removed proxy from network prefs. ssh to bastion works now. :tada:

sre-oncall: great. two followups: 1) onboarding doc should warn about third-party proxy agents that hijack system proxy settings, 2) add a quick check to the first-login script: detect non-empty `scutil --proxy` entries and surface a warning with a link to steps to disable.

infra-bot: NET-5509 created: "onboard: detect & warn about local proxy agents interfering with WireGuard" assigned to eng-infra.

elaine: tariq, would you mind adding a short blurb to the onboarding doc describing the symptom + `scutil --proxy` check? small PR is fine.

tariq (newhire): will do. thanks for the quick help everyone! :relieved:

grant: adding this to the checklist so new hires are prompted to run the proxy check during setup. :white_check_mark:
